description: Details of one place: names in five languages, coordinates, kind, the area guide it belongs to, a short description, sights within walking distance, upcoming events nearby, related themes, lines that stop there (for stations), and the URL of its page. Returns id, kind, name, names, lat, lng, area, about (description, typical stay, fee, rainy-day and step-free notes; only for sights), station (lines, lockers, step-free access; only for stations), highlights (walkable sights and classics in the same area), eventsHere, eventsNearby, themes, page, routesToHerePage.

id.description: Place ID or sight ID returned by search_places or find_nearby (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens).

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

name: get_place
title: Get details of a place
